about: Final-week polls against results, Netanyahu-aligned bloc, every election under the 3.25% threshold. 'field' is the mean of the final poll of each firm other than Direct Polls / Shlomo Filber's firms; 'directPolls' is that firm's final poll where it published one in the final week. Source: Wikipedia opinion-polling pages for each election, read 2026-10-23. Bloc definitions follow the tables: 2015 Likud+Jewish Home+Shas+UTJ+Yisrael Beiteinu+Yachad; Apr 2019 the right bloc incl. Kulanu and YB; Sep 2019 and Mar 2020 Likud+Shas+UTJ+Yamina; 2021 Likud+Shas+UTJ+RZ; 2022 Likud+Shas+UTJ+RZ.

thresholdLists.about: Lists shown at 4-5 seats by most final-week polls, and whether they passed.

perListError.about: theMadad, 2022: mean absolute error per list in polls 0-14 days before the vote.
